changelog: v1 (2026-10-16, K6-N2): current private read-model mapping; legacy serving and K0a assertion-slice evidence remain separate.
interpretation: (I) INTERPRETATION: version-specific private preparation evidence, not changes to live asset_declarations or production certificates. Alternative: overwrite legacy serving declarations with unmeasured candidate claims.

carriage.served_surface: private candidate; no live serving claim

legacy_serving.scope: Legacy surface only; does not read or certify the private candidate projection.

ldgr_source.state: Embedded typed source/provenance by row_kind; fixture locators and upstream_refs are not admitted live source resolution.

null_convention.probability: No probability, confidence, quality or numeric composite is introduced.
null_convention.unmeasured: No full-table or live null grading claimed.

semantic_fingerprint.inputs: Pinned judge assertions, three separate valences, matching negative-space states, jury D(W)/witness/segments, optional forecaster estimand and coverage contexts
semantic_fingerprint.outputs: Judge and contextual rows retain all evidence; absent negative-space mapping is information_unavailable with named reason; signed/zero forecaster values retained without composite or probability

disposition: built, waiting on gate; private fixtures only
acceptance_gates: V-K6 dependency, independent exact-head review, deploy containment, live admission, protected operations, parent completion and K9-4b publication remain separate. Registrar validation alone cannot complete K8-K6; K6-4 mapping belongs to its implementation.

Build.expected_reading: UNMEASURED: fixture dispatch and real SQL chart/build integrity oracles exist; registry count is latest chart build while integrity is the exact transaction-bound chart/build, including completed builds. Canonical orchestrated completion, dependencies and build history remain unmeasured.

Idem.expected_reading: UNMEASURED: fixture repeat rebuild and empty rebuild replace only the chart/generation partition through the shared helper; published/retained and legacy rows remain intact. Static helper attribution and live structural detector reading remain unmeasured.

Earn.expected_reading: UNMEASURED: fixture WriterResult and SQL output are measured by local oracles; real production build_record, service state and timing are unmeasured.

Vocab.expected_reading: UNMEASURED: fixture model_key preserves natural identities and scenario/convention distinctions. No live natural-key or alias verdict; vocab_alias is null until independently measured.

Ldgr.expected_reading: UNMEASURED: fixture payload embeds upstream evidence/provenance and upstream_refs pins build, scenario, ayanamsha, source locator and fixture qualification. Source presence is distinct from live id resolution and classical sourcing.

Dens.expected_reading: UNMEASURED: fixture rows store tier=contextual|testimony|fixture_only; no served SELECT reads these private tables. Legacy serving evidence below is separate and cannot certify candidate density.

Narr.expected_reading: UNMEASURED: fixture SQL projects supplied evidence without composed narrative; copied dossier/source text means no blanket prose_none claim. Bound semantic fidelity tests do not certify live prose or the mixed legacy surfaces.

Null.expected_reading: UNMEASURED: fixture coverage is reason-bearing, judge valences stay separate and nullable, and missing negative-space behavior is declared per asset. Both live null graders and live declarations remain unmeasured.

Carr.expected_reading: NO_DETECTOR for Carr.D2 at current registry revision; fixture SQL derivation and fidelity evidence do not establish independent D3 or live carriage. Other carriage readings remain unmeasured.
Carr.detector_dependency: A subsequent criterion-registry revision implementing the currently NONE detector and independent measurement are required; no production certificate.
